description: Utimaco Enterprise Secure Key Manager (ESKM) provides key generation, retrieval, and management for encryption devices and solutions. ESKM is a hardened security appliance with secure access control, administration, and logging. ESKM supports high availability with automatic multi-site clustering, replication, and failover.
